title: AI Proposals Inbox: make AI-generated next-step proposals visible and actionable in Mission Control
goal: The AI agent (api/app/services/ai_agent.py) runs post-task analysis after every completed tool run and generates proposals (AgentProposal records) with fields: proposed_tool, proposed_target, proposed_params, risk_tier (passive/active/intrusive), confidence_score, and reasoning. These proposals are stored in the database but are NOT visible in the operator UI in any meaningful way. Operators cannot see what the AI wants to do next. Fix: (1) Add an 'AI Proposals' panel to Mission Control that lists pending proposals for the active run, showing: tool icon, target, confidence score, risk tier badge, and a one-line reasoning summary. (2) Each proposal has Approve / Reject buttons. Approved proposals are dispatched as queued tasks. Rejected proposals are marked rejected and removed from view. (3) Show a badge count on the Mission Control nav item when proposals are pending: 'Mission Control ● 3'. (4) The panel should appear alongside or below the AI Signal panel in Mission Control. (5) Add GET /api/v1/engagements/{id}/runs/{run_id}/ai-proposals endpoint if not already present to load proposals for the active run.
scope: Code audit 2026-05-03: api/app/services/ai_agent.py is 1,251 lines fully implementing post-task AI analysis. AgentProposal records are created with tool/target/params/confidence/reasoning but there is no UI panel in Mission Control or anywhere else that shows these proposals to operators. The system is generating AI recommendations that operators cannot see or act on.
generation_reason: AI proposals generated by 1,251-line agent are stored in DB but invisible to operators — they need a visible inbox to review and approve.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Add the proposals panel and approve/reject actions. Do not change the AI agent logic, proposal generation, or dispatch mechanism.

success_criteria: Mission Control shows a 'Suggested Next Steps' panel listing pending AgentProposal records for the active run.
Each proposal shows: tool, target, risk tier badge (passive/active/intrusive), confidence %, one-line reason.
Approve button dispatches the proposal as a queued task.
Reject button marks it rejected and removes from panel.
Nav badge count updates when proposals are pending.
Panel hidden when no proposals exist.
No regression in Mission Control E2E tests.

acceptance_criteria: AI proposals panel renders in Mission Control.
Approve action dispatches proposal as task.
Reject action removes proposal from panel.
